title: Danganronpa Decadence
synopsis: The three mainline Danganronpa games and Ultimate Summer Camp on one card — retained as Spike Chunsoft’s Nintendo Switch edition.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Danganronpa traps students of an elite academy in a killing game where each murder must be exposed in a Class Trial. Decadence gathers Trigger Happy Havoc, Goodbye Despair, and Killing Harmony in their Anniversary Editions, with the new board-game spin-off Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp.

Spike Chunsoft released it in Japan on November 4, 2021, and in North America on December 3, 2021 — the series’ first appearance on Nintendo Switch, with all four games on a single card.

This filing opens the Danganronpa lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Spike Chunsoft’s retail edition of Danganronpa Decadence on a Nintendo Switch game card, holding all four games.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: The first Danganronpa released on PSP in Japan in 2010. Decadence released in Japan on November 4, 2021, and North America on December 3, 2021 (HAC-P-A3TUA); a Collector’s Edition was issued alongside.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Spike Chunsoft, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
